# Eden Docs

> Documentation for Eden Observability — tracing, auto-instrumentation, evals, and governance for AI agents.

Primary product site: https://edenobservability.com/ (see also https://edenobservability.com/llms.txt).

## Raw markdown

Every HTML doc page is also available as raw markdown: append `.md` to the
permalink (Langfuse-style). Frontmatter is preserved. Examples:

- https://docs.edenobservability.com/quickstart.md
- https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/deploy.md
- https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to.md (section index; HTML is `/how-to`)
- https://docs.edenobservability.com/index.md (docs home; HTML is `/`)

## Start here

- [Docs home](https://docs.edenobservability.com/): Documentation overview ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/index.md))
- [Quickstart](https://docs.edenobservability.com/quickstart): Signup to first trace in minutes ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/quickstart.md))
- [Deploy](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/deploy): Connect your app to api.edenobservability.com ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/deploy.md))
- [Auto-instrument](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auto-instrument): Instrument an existing Python or TypeScript repo ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auto-instrument.md))
- [Security model](https://docs.edenobservability.com/explanation/security-model): Tenant isolation, PII redaction, audit defaults ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/explanation/security-model.md))

## How-to

- [How-to index](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/): Task-oriented guides ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to.md))
- [Auth](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auth): Authentication ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auth.md))
- [API keys](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/api-keys): Create and manage API keys ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/api-keys.md))
- [Connect any agent](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/connect-any-agent): Integration patterns for agents ([markdown](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/connect-any-agent.md))
